description: Na₃GeTe₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.57 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.13-3.74 Å. Ge is bonded to one Ge and three Te atoms to form distorted GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TeNa₆Ge pentagonal bipyramid. The Ge-Ge bond length is 2.50 Å. There is one shorter (2.61 Å) and two longer (2.62 Å) Ge-Te bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded to six Na and one Ge atom to form distorted TeNa₆Ge pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent TeNa₆Ge pentagonal bipyramids. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ge atom. In the third Te site, Te is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ge atom.
